verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos through his stun-into-mark combo before level 6; you win if you lead with E and disengage before he lands a second Frenzied Maul.

brief.thesis: Volibear's whole kit is built to win extended trades: Q stuns and closes distance, W marks you and rewards a second cast with bonus damage and a heal, and his passive stacks Attack Speed off every action he takes. Malphite's E (Ground Slam) deals magic damage scaled off his own Armor and cuts enemy Attack Speed for a short duration, which directly blunts the on-hit chain Volibear needs to proc that heal. The matchup is even on paper (52% Malphite win rate over 1520 games) because whoever controls trade length wins — short pokes favor you, long ones favor him.

theirWindow.what: Thundering Smash gains him speed toward you and stuns the first target his Attack hits, on a 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cooldown. Don't stand and trade through the stun — the moment he commits to the dash, use your own Q (Seismic Shard, 8s cooldown) to steal his movement speed and create distance before he can auto-chain into it.

yourWindow.when: right after you land E (Ground Slam)
yourWindow.what: Ground Slam's Attack Speed reduction cuts into the on-hit procs that feed Frenzied Maul's mark and heal. Follow it immediately with W (Brutal Strikes) autos while his Attack Speed is suppressed — that's the window where your trade actually outpaces his.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 73.7% pick rate at 52.2% win rate over 1429 games — the mana and sustain let you keep casting E and Q through his early poke without running dry.

boots.why: 53% win rate over 857 games; Volibear's W and passive are both auto-attack and on-hit driven, and Steelcaps directly reduces that incoming damage.

core.why: Highest-winrate core path (57.7% over 52 games) and its burn punishes his habit of sitting in on-hit range.
Grievous Wounds cuts directly into the heal he gets off a second Frenzied Maul cast.
Armor scales your E's damage directly, and the Attack Speed slow further dulls his on-hit chain.

you need the burn healing-reduction effect against his W heal instead of Thornmail's armor profile

runes.keystoneWhy: This page runs a higher win rate (53.8% vs 51.7%) and the per-trade heal directly offsets the sustained poke damage Volibear's on-hit kit applies over a long lane.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs the highest win rate at 53.9% over a real 24.2% pick sample — the early kill pressure matters here since Volibear holds the solo-kill advantage and you want a way to punish his all-in attempts before he scales.

playing.title: Deny the double W proc
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul marks you on first cast and deals bonus damage plus heals him on the second cast of the same target. If he marks you, disengage past 325 range instead of trading through it — letting the second cast land swings the whole exchange.

playing.title: Use your Q to slip his Q
playing.detail: Thundering Smash gap-closes and stuns on a 12-10s cooldown. The instant he commits to it, cast Seismic Shard to steal his movement speed so he can't immediately re-close after the stun wears off.

playing.title: Trade with E before W
playing.detail: Ground Slam's damage scales off your own Armor and cuts his Attack Speed for a short duration. Open trades with E to blunt his on-hit kit, then follow with Brutal Strikes autos while he's slowed down.

playing.title: Save R for his commitment
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 and only drops to 80s at rank 5 — don't spend it to start fights early. Hold it to punish his Q engage or peel him off you once the cooldown is short enough to use freely.

playing.title: Respect Sky Splitter's zone
playing.detail: Sky Splitter is a 1200-range strike that slows and shields him if he's standing in the blast when it lands. Don't group with him in open space past level 6, where he can layer E on top of a Q stun.

playing.title: Play a tight leash early
playing.detail: Volibear holds the solo-kill edge through level 5 per the measured data. Don't contest trades until your passive shield and E are both off cooldown — freeze the wave on your side if he's looking to all-in.

playing.title: Stack Armor as damage, not just defense
playing.detail: Since Ground Slam's damage scales off your Armor stat, Thornmail and Frozen Heart aren't purely defensive picks here — they raise your trade damage and your tankiness in the same slot.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade timing, cooldown windows, and tactical reads layered on top are our own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Volibear’s second (W). If he closes in using (Q), respond by using [Q] to retreat.
